Change a goal, archive it or restore it. Fields that are left out stay as they are. A
new title, description or keywords give the goal a new version.

post.description:
Make this the focus goal. There is at most one focus goal. An archived goal cannot be
the focus: 409.

get.description: The process is up. Checks nothing else, so a database outage does not restart the API.

get.description: A page of the item's history, newest first.

put.description:
Confirm or reject the score of one goal for this item. A null label removes the verdict.

With ``score``, the score that you saw: when the score changed since, the answer is a 409.

get.description:
Exactly what the public feed would hold for this item if it were published now, shown
before publishing. Nothing is saved. A copy of another item cannot be published: 409.

post.description:
Send a failed or finished item back to the start of the pipeline.

The answer comes at once and the work happens later, on the worker. An item that is still
being processed cannot be sent back: 409.

get.description: The saved items that are closest in meaning to this one.

post.description:
Move the item to another reading status. A move the state machine forbids is a 409, and
so is a move into a full reading queue. The status that the item has already is no error.

put.description:
Publish the item with the record of its preview, or make it private again.

The item becomes public only with the record that the owner saw: if the record changed
after the preview, or the preview is more than an hour old, the answer is a 409 and
nothing changes. The same visibility again is no error.
